scope: All 600 current entries; all 11700 same-level pairs; 560 neighboring-level comparisons
method: Jaccard of exact Korean sentences and space-delimited eojeol trigrams; threshold .65 is diagnostic, not semantic proof

aiEditorialReview.review: Checked chronology, Korean/English sentence alignment, explicit evidence and contradiction/overstatement in inference distractors. Literal option checks cannot prove semantic uniqueness; these ten templates were separately read against their full context.

limitations: All 40 stories intentionally grow through adjacent levels: prefix repetition remains.
600 entries are graded variants of 40 story families, not 600 independent stories.
Difficulty metrics do not establish CEFR/TOPIK calibration or beginner learning effectiveness.
No teacher approval or learner trial.
